fields.description:
Header stats derived from related Deals, using DLRS because these are lookup relationships.

=== FIELDS ===

* On Operator: Active Deals (count where Deal Status = Active) / Supported Verticals (distinct) / Supported Markets (distinct Country/State)

* On Partner: Operators (distinct count) / Active Deals (count where Deal Status = Active)

=== IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS ===

* Use DLRS, not out-of-the-box rollup summary fields. Kobi, Aug 17: 'Salesforce has its own out of the box rollup fields. They are limited to I believe just master detail relationships. So lookup relationships don't necessarily work with the out of the box one. So we use something called the DLRS.' Deal->Operator and Deal->Partner are both lookups.

* Ticket convention Kobi stated: 'I'll usually specify that in the ticket if we need to use DLRS versus the other one.' Every rollup ticket names the engine.

* Distinct-value rollups (Verticals, Markets) reuse the pattern Phase 1 already used for the Market Country/State summary — DLRS CONCATENATE, Flow as fallback.

* All read-only. No edit pencil on the mockup, consistent with rollups.

* Remember the two renamed child relationships from BUILD-132 — Deals Partner and Deals Operator. The Operator rollup uses one, the Partner rollup the other. Getting this backwards is a silent failure.

=== OPEN QUESTIONS ===

* SCOPE OWED. Aug 17, 01:07:16: 'I'll scope out the logic for the rollups and I'll let you know what those are and you can probably work on those as well afterwards.' Taryn is waiting on it — the rollups are on her explicit skipped list.

* Joyce said she wants to 'get more granular in terms of verticals and markets when you get down to the operator level' but gave no spec. Does distinct-value concatenation actually satisfy her?

=== NOTES ===

* BUILD-147 depends on the Active Deals count from this card.

* Taryn was told to skip these earlier: 'we have a set of items that you told me to skip over, like the roll ups and the partner related ID, contact related ID, lookups.' This card unblocks that.

* Provenance: OP-8, PT-8.

=== SOURCE ===

* Taryn doc OP-8 / PT-8

* Aug 13 call — active-only counting

* Aug 17 call — DLRS is the standard, Kobi to scope

Dependencies: Deal object

Owner (proposed): Kobi Kunasekaran (scope) -> Taryn Reithofer (build)

Remember to update the requirements documentation as part of this change.

Created 2026-08-17 from the Operator/Partner ticket review, approved by Kobi.

comments.body:
Active Deals rollups built for Operator and Partner via DLRS. Confirmed working: Full Calculate and real-time recalculation on Deal Status change both correct.

Split into two fields, not one shared field — Active_Deals\__c (Operatorc relationship) and Active_Deals_Partnerc (Partner_\_c relationship). A single shared field doesn't work with two independent DLRS rules: each rollup's Full Calculate resets the field to 0 for records it doesn't own, wiping out the other rollup's values.

Still outstanding on this ticket: Supported Verticals, Supported Markets, and Partner's Operators (distinct count) — waiting on Kobi's scope per the open question above.

Outstanding DLRS for -

Operators: Verticals and Markets

Partner: Operators

- [x] Get clarification from the client on what "Supported Markets" actually means

* Does "Supported Markets" mean just states/provinces, or states _and_ country codes together?
* Do they want every possible variation represented, or is there a narrower set they're actually after?  

- [x] Build a spreadsheet listing out every possible value/combination this field could represent, using the Deal object's existing Market Country/Market State logic as the reference pattern. (cheaper to find that out from a spreadsheet than from a built-out Salesforce structure.)

* Use the Deal object's existing Market Country / Market State pattern as the template for how to structure this.
Supported markets has its own ticket now, see linked work items.
